label: AVONET: morphological, ecological and geographical data for all birds (Supplementary dataset 1)
bibliographic_citation: Tobias JA, Sheard C, Pigot AL, Devenish AJM, Yang J, Sayol F, et al. (2022) AVONET: morphological, ecological and geographical data for all birds. Ecology Letters 25:581–597. https://doi.org/10.1111/ele.13898

distributions.description: figshare article metadata listing the file and its md5

counts.description: species-rank bird taxa of this slice whose binomial occurs as a shared string in the workbook (xl/sharedStrings.xml); each occurs at least once across the AVONET1_BirdLife/AVONET2_eBird/AVONET3_BirdTree sheets

measurement_technique: Museum-specimen and field measurements of 11 continuous morphological traits (beak, wing, tail, tarsus, mass) for ~90,000 individuals, averaged per species, plus ecological and range attributes.
role: morphological trait means (beak, wing, tarsus, mass) and range size for the listed birds

integrity.checked_via: figshare landing page returned HTTP 202 and api.figshare.com/v2/articles/16586228 HTTP 200; file md5 matches figshare supplied_md5

notes: Only the sharedStrings table of the workbook was parsed (no spreadsheet library); row-level trait values were not extracted.
